# sentry_organization_data_scrubbing (Resource)

The organization-wide server-side data scrubbing settings, which apply to every project on top of the project's own. There is one per organization, so creating this resource takes it over; declare it once. Destroying this resource only stops managing the settings: they stay as they are, since resetting them could switch scrubbing off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Applies to every project of the organization. Declare it once.
resource "sentry_organization_data_scrubbing" "this" {
  data_scrubber          = true
  data_scrubber_defaults = true

  safe_fields = ["request_id"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_scrubber` (Boolean) Whether server-side data scrubbing is on for every project of the organization. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `data_scrubber_defaults` (Boolean) Whether Sentry's default scrubbers, for things like passwords and credit card numbers, apply. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `safe_fields` (Set of String) Field names the scrubbers leave alone. An empty set clears the list. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `scrub_ip_addresses` (Boolean) Whether client IP addresses are kept out of stored events. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.
- `sensitive_fields` (Set of String) Additional field names to scrub. An empty set clears the list. When unset, Sentry's current setting is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one per organization; the ID given here is ignored.
terraform import sentry_organization_data_scrubbing.this organization
```
